part_number: Socket Set Screws - Metric spec sheet
description: Unbrako metric socket set screws, high-grade alloy steel: seating torque, axial holding power, torsional holding power by shaft diameter
notes: Reference, not a purchase. Per screw. The sheet says the values are 'typical strengths' to be used 'with specific safety factors'. It covers knurled/plain cup, flat and cone points; the table does not split by point type. Torsional values equal axial x shaft radius (checked: 1.70 kN x 4 mm = 6.8 N*m). An aluminium hub and the Phidgets pulleys' 2x M4 into 2024 aluminium will not reach full seating torque without stripping, so derate. Unbrako's guide says full holding needs about a 10 Rc point difference between screw and shaft. Practicalmaintenance.wordpress.com quotes Unbrako at M3 0.92 / M4 2.2 / M5 4.0 N*m seating torque (older edition).

description: Gates belt tensile properties table: 2M PowerGrip GT2, neoprene / fibreglass
notes: Reference, not a purchase. Gates doc 17611-T (Mar 2007, hosted by MIT). Notes: all data is for the standard neoprene/fibreglass construction; working tensions assume near-minimum pulleys and <300 rpm; ultimate strength is 'not appropriate for use in belt drive design'. Steel-cord GT2 is a non-Gates variant (generic sellers), and this table has no data for it. With the 22T PD 14.006 mm, 26.2 N working tension is about 0.18 N*m (computed: 26.2 N x 7.003 mm) of belt-limited torque at the 22T, or about 0.50 N*m at the 60T output (computed: 26.2 N x 19.10 mm), compare with the STS3215/STS3250 rated torque (TBD: from the Feetech datasheet, part 1 of the research). If the servo torque is higher, the 6 mm belt, not the servo, sets the joint limit.

item: Gates 3M HTD and 3M GT2 belt ratings (reference)
description: Gates belt tensile properties: 3M PowerGrip HTD and 3M PowerGrip GT2
notes: Reference, not a purchase. Same Gates table and caveats as the 2M entry. 3M GT2 at 9 mm is about 6.9x the working tension of 2M GT2 at 6 mm (computed: 179.6/26.2). That is the strongest upgrade path if the shoulder needs more torque than a 6 mm 2GT carries; pulleys grow (3 mm pitch: 22T PD = 21.01 mm, computed).

item: 22:60 GT2 centre distances by belt length (computed reference)
description: Exact open-belt pitch-line solution for 22T:60T GT2 (2 mm), L = 2C cos(phi) + pi(D+d)/2 + phi(D-d), sin(phi) = (D-d)/2C
notes: Reference, not a purchase. Nominal pitch-line values with no tension allowance. Leave about +/-1 mm of adjustment, or an idler, for belt tolerance and pretension. The Phidgets pulley ODs (13.51 and 37.69 mm) clear each other at every length listed.
